label: PF Backlog 581
title: Per-worker sync hardening: sync at task start + pre-commit auto-sync + worker-charter guideline (BI-PF-1290 follow-up)
body:
## Problem / why
BI-PF-1290 added sync_develop.py + a pre-push hook, but nothing syncs DURING implementation - only at push time.
A session that codes for hours drifts the whole time, then faces a big late merge. The guideline/behavior also
lives only in AGENTS.md, not the worker charter a working agent reads.

## Goal & value
Keep every session near origin/develop all the time (minimal clash/conflicts): sync when a task STARTS, before
every COMMIT, and before every PUSH - plus an explicit guideline so the worker knows why/when.

## In scope
- scripts/dev/sync_develop.py: add a --pre-commit mode (safe: merge develop as its own clean commit, then exit 1
  so the user re-runs the commit; abort cleanly on a source conflict). Share the hook logic with --pre-push.
- install_hooks.py: run the sync in the pre-commit hook (FIRST, before the doc-regen/guards, so it is not run
  against already-staged changes).
- workergrid/instructions.md + AGENTS.md: the "stay close to develop - sync often" guideline (commands + why).

## Out of scope
- A background/scheduled job (git state is per working tree; cannot span sessions; would race the editor).

## Approach
Reuse sync_develop.py + the existing hook installer. The mock/message differs per hook; the merge logic is shared.

## Acceptance criteria
- sync_develop.py --pre-commit merges is its own commit then exits 1 (re-run commit); aborts on source conflict;
  exits 0 when up to date.
- The pre-commit hook runs the sync first.
- The guideline is present in the worker charter + AGENTS.
- Tests cover --pre-commit; precheck passes.

## Risks
- The pre-commit sync adds a merge commit; harmless but noisier history when behind. Mitigation: only fires when
  actually behind.

## Rollback
Remove the hook line + the mode; sync still available via the CLI and the pre-push hook.

## Related
Follow-up to BI-PF-1290 (sync_develop + pre-push). Epic BI-PF-0360.
